name: Manan Singh
title: Hi, I'm Manan.
intro: I study Robotics and Computer Science at Purdue University. I'm passionate about building robots and automation solutions that make the world a better place. For fun, I build and compete with BattleBots.
about: This is a home for the things I build and the work behind them. Explore my engineering projects, see the robots in action on YouTube, or follow along on Instagram.
